entities.name: Eugène Lanti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugène Lanti was a pseudonym of Eugène Aristide Alfred Adam, an Esperantist, socialist and writer. He was a founder of Sennacieca Asocio Tutmonda, and a longtime editor of the internationalist socialist magazine Sennaciulo. Lanti was a critic of Stalinism and the theoretician of a new doctrine, anationalism, which aimed to eliminate the very concept of the nation as a guiding idea of social organisation.
